method: Full source and contract-document inspection; immutable mode/blob identities; existing helper, browser configuration and source-contract comparison. No new runtime/native execution by this review.
findings: HTTPS fixture uses owned temporary loopback TLS material, fixed OpenSSL arguments, intercepted synthetic RPC and cleanup at all resource layers. It asserts secure context, signed-invoice review without RPC, saved scan preference, selected-chain test and wrong-chain refusal. It does not certify Tor routing.

Comparator accepts its explicit complete snapshot contract, validates immutable commit objects, disables replacements/lazy fetch, rejects shallow/grafted history, preserves mode/type/deletions and noncomparable histories. It writes only its chosen report/temp file and does not change refs or execute workflows.

Formatter enforces its bounded five-report shape and selected fields; positional target labels and zero findings do not authenticate execution or establish clearance. Existing analyzer gates remain unchanged.
Original tests and interfaces remain, with explicit input/evidence limits; no current-census adapter or native/analyzer success is inferred.
